name: babble-xiaohe-baseline-v1
defaultCharacters: 走现声其无生大带见平延欺背举升即夜断继蝉蠢视觉途
controlCharacters: 某你我中木水花是不书
limitations: This is an experimental baseline, not a complete Xiaohe configuration.
The target itself is excluded from the root inventory for that target; no complete single-root-character policy is implemented.
First/last root inventories come from the existing licensed libre-flypy source; segmentation uses their union and rejects endpoints absent from the corresponding side.
Named components, Xiaohe-derived small characters, insertion/separation and enclosure priorities still need explicit definitions and regressions.
A reference match is a review candidate, never authorization to publish the remote glyph data or an automatic runtime import.
